raw_html: [[Magma Surge|Legendary Magma Surge]][[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]'''[[Magma Surge|Legendary Magma Surge]]:''' This item stores the immeasurable heat of the planet's molten mantle. When this weapon is used, superheated magma occasionally flows to the surface, slowing an enemy down and inflicting massive fire damage over time.
